README: Ella's Recipe Book — Ingredient Price List (single source of truth for recipe costing)
• Prices tab: one row per ingredient pack you buy. ₹ per g / ml / piece is calculated for you. Change a price here and every recipe cost updates on the next site build.
• One row per ingredient is the Default (Default = Y). Recipes use the default row unless a brand is specified. Extra rows (other brands/stores) sit alongside for later brand-level costing.
• Yield %: edible portion after trimming (100% = nothing wasted; e.g. chicken with bone 70%).
• Updated on: date you last checked the price. Anything older than 60 days is flagged.
• Aliases tab: other names recipes use (dahi, jeera, haldi …) → the ingredient name in Prices. 'Confirm?' = my guess, please check.
• Units tab: DRAFT conversions (tsp / tbsp / cup, grams per ml, grams per piece). Edit freely.
• Serves tab: how many people each recipe serves. Fill the yellow cells.
• Don't rename ingredients in the Prices tab without telling Claude — recipes are matched on the Ingredient name.
• Leave a price blank if unknown; it will appear on the gaps list instead of being costed as ₹0.
